accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.desc: See who you’re signed in as for GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Fabric, the Azure CLI, and GitHub, and sign in or out.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.desc: Use models from Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI and Google with your own API keys, next to your Copilot models. The provider bills you for them.

mcpServers.title: MCP servers
mcpServers.desc: Add the MCP servers chat can turn on in its Plugins, such as a command that runs on this computer or a server’s URL.

chatDefaults.title: Chat defaults
chatDefaults.desc: The model and plugins a new project’s chat starts with.

customInstructions.title: Custom instructions
customInstructions.desc: What Copilot follows in every app you build, such as “Use the system theme by default.”

setup.title: Setup
setup.desc: Check the tools Fabricator needs and install missing ones, such as the GitHub CLI.

theme.title: Theme
theme.desc: System follows your computer’s light or dark setting.

language.title: Language
language.desc: System uses your computer’s language when Fabricator comes in it, and English otherwise.

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.desc: Scale the whole interface — handy on large monitors.

usage.title: Usage stats
usage.desc: We send your sign-in domain and a hashed email so we can see how the product is used. Your email, code, and apps stay on this device.

full.title: Full diagnostics
full.desc: Also capture prompts, responses, and tool output for each chat turn. Off by default — only lightweight metadata (timing, tools used, errors) is recorded. Turn on to include more detail in a bug report.

logs.title: Logs
logs.desc: Diagnostics for your chat sessions are saved on this device. Export them to attach to a bug report.

experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.desc: These features are experimental and off by default. They may be unstable, change, or be removed in a future update.

teamWorkspaces.title: Team workspaces
teamWorkspaces.desc: Build apps with your team in a private GitHub repository. Everyone works on their own copy, and a pipeline publishes to Fabric with a deploy identity that Fabricator sets up. Team apps never deploy from this computer. Needs the GitHub CLI.

reportMigration.title: Migrate Power BI reports
reportMigration.desc: Turn a Power BI report into a new app from Home. The app reads the report's semantic model live, and Copilot rebuilds the report's pages, visuals and filters one page at a time. Needs the Azure CLI.

workIq.title: Work IQ
workIq.desc: Add Work IQ to chat's plugins. Turned on in a chat, it lets chat look up your Microsoft 365 email, meetings, files, Teams messages and people, with Microsoft's Work IQ, and use what it finds while it builds. Read-only. You sign in with your work account in your browser. Needs a Microsoft 365 Copilot license and your organization's approval.

help.title: Help
help.desc: Guides for every part of Fabricator, and fixes for common problems.
